title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
abstract: arXiv:2611.19013v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. translated_title: MemoryLane：利用模拟AI智能体支持轻度痴呆老年人与非专业照护者之间的回忆对话
translated_abstract: 回忆疗法是一种非药物干预方法，邀请患者讨论和回顾过去的生活经历与记忆，以改善其情绪和心理健康。在实践中，许多回忆对话由非专业照护者（如配偶和成年子女）主导。虽然传统的回忆疗法通常依赖于个人照片，但整理这些照片可能既繁琐又困难。此外，缺乏与患者共同生活经历的照护者可能难以开展引人入胜的回忆对话。本文提出了MemoryLane，这是一个集成AI的工具，可帮助非专业照护者在无需整理照片的情况下开展回忆对话。MemoryLane支持患者、照护者与一个充当患者同龄人的模拟AI智能体之间的三方对话。共享界面展示该智能体以及正在讨论的记忆的AI生成图像，同时还有一个私人智能手机界面……
tldr: MemoryLane通过模拟AI智能体充当患者的同龄人并生成记忆相关图像，帮助非专业照护者在无需整理个人照片的情况下与轻度痴呆老年人开展有效的回忆对话。
en_tdlr: MemoryLane uses a simulated AI agent acting as the patient's peer, along with AI-generated memory images, to help lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations with older adults with mild dementia without requiring curated personal photographs.
